collections.name: The Estate Collection
collections.description: Flagship play environments for master-planned communities, resorts, and campuses — commanding in scale, composed in detail.

collections.name: The Tower Collection
collections.description: Classic play towers and swing systems for gardens, courtyards, and community greens — the essential Soliwood forms.

collections.name: The Early Years Collection
collections.description: Playhouses, sensory play, and toddler-scaled environments for nurseries and family amenities.

collections.name: The Adventure Collection
collections.description: Climbing, agility, and challenge elements — standalone or composed into continuous circuits.

collections.name: The Landscape Collection
collections.description: Site furniture that completes the setting — benches and forms in the same design language as the play structures they face.

products.name: Forest House
products.description: A complete play landscape in richly toned timber: four towers, connecting bridges, seven slides, and a full circuit of climbing, swinging, and social elements beneath the canopy. Designed as a destination amenity, Forest House transforms a shared green into the most valuable square meters of a development.

products.name: Jungle City
products.description: Three elevated cabins under solid timber roofs, linked at height and grounded by a full swing and agility program — monkey bars, tire swing, Tarzan ladder, and slide. Jungle City rewards confident climbers while its guarded decks keep supervision effortless.

products.name: Tower House
products.description: Three roofed towers connected by crawl tunnels form a continuous elevated journey, served by four slides and a dedicated swing bay with toddler seat. A composition of remarkable breadth, serving mixed age groups simultaneously — an ideal centerpiece for school grounds and family resorts.

products.name: Bridge House
products.description: Twin peaked-roof towers joined by an elevated bridge, with a sweeping slide, triple swing beam, and a complete climbing program below. Bridge House delivers the silhouette of a grand garden folly with the engineering of commercial-grade play equipment.

products.name: Swing House
products.description: A single stately tower commanding an exceptional six-seat swing program — the highest swing capacity in the collection. Where communal energy matters most, Swing House keeps every child in motion at once.

products.name: Dream House
products.description: The archetypal Soliwood tower: deep-stained timber, a shingled roof, twin-lane slide, rock climbing ramp, rope ladder, and a full swing beam. Dream House is the collection's most photographed silhouette — and its most requested.

products.name: Pirate Ship Fort
products.description: A full-hulled timber vessel with mast, sail, and twin observation decks, run aground in sand or safety surfacing. Rock wall to port, wave slide amidships, swings astern — a narrative environment that turns a beachfront or courtyard into a landmark.
contents: Wooden Pirate Ship Hull with Anchor Detail (1)
Main Mast with Sail & Pennant Flag (1)

products.name: Trampoline & Play Tower System
products.description: A gabled lookout tower and extra-wide wave slide paired with a fully enclosed ground-level trampoline court. The integration of bounce, climb, and slide in a single engineered footprint makes this system a singular draw for resort and clubhouse settings.
contents: Elevated Lookout Tower with Gabled Roof (1)
Ground-Level Trampoline with Safety Netting Enclosure (1)
Swing Beam with Heavy-Duty A-Frame Supports (1)

products.name: Wooden Bridge Fort
products.description: Two shed-roofed cabins linked by a guarded bridge, with twin slides, crawl tunnels, a ground-level chalkboard, and integrated planters and bench. Bridge Fort is scaled and detailed for schoolyards — sociable, supervisable, and quietly beautiful.

products.name: Grand Activity Landscape
products.description: An expansive golden-timber terrain of towers, spiral and wave slides, balance elements, and heavy-duty swings, composed as a continuous adventure circuit. Specified by resorts where the playground is itself an amenity photographed in the brochure.

products.name: Multi-Block Slide Pavilion
products.description: Three linked decks under twin roofs, connected by a barrel tunnel and served by single and double slides. Its modular block architecture allows the composition to be mirrored, extended, or reconfigured to the site plan.

products.name: Double Trampoline & Swing Combo
products.description: Twin enclosed timber trampoline cubes flanking an overhead monkey-bar swing beam — a full agility court that pairs vertical bounce with horizontal traverse. Engineered for high-throughput settings where multiple children arrive together and leave breathless.
contents: Enclosed Wooden Trampoline Tower Cubes with Protective Mesh Netting Panels (2)
Rectangular Inbuilt Trampolines with Green Safety Padding (2)
Overhead Monkey Bar Swing Beam Structure (1)
Flexible Belt Swing Seats with Chain Supports (3)
Slanted Wooden Access Ladder with Metal Handrails (1)
Low-Level Ramped / Step Access Support Frames

products.name: Knight's Castle Oakfort
products.description: A crenellated castle tower with wave slide and double swing beam, complete with lookout binoculars for young sentries. Oakfort's storybook profile is matched by thoroughly modern engineering — enclosed hardware, hand grips, and guarded platforms throughout.

products.name: Play Tower Castle
products.description: Twin towers under a pointed spire roof, joined by a bridge and equipped with a 2.7 m wave slide, double swings, and three distinct climbing routes. A vertical, elegant composition that reads beautifully against residential architecture.

products.name: Marvel Play Tower
products.description: A roofed lookout tower with fireman's pole, wavy slide, and an integrated sandpit sheltered beneath the deck. Compact in plan yet complete in program — the connoisseur's choice for private gardens and boutique developments.

products.name: Storm Flyer
products.description: A ship-form climbing frame with prow, wheelhouse, wobbly bridge, and water-connected wave slide, rising from twin integrated sandpits. Storm Flyer is a complete nautical world in under twenty-five square meters of safety zone.
contents: Wave Slide with Water Connection, 220 cm (1)

products.name: Smart Zone with SurfSwing
products.description: The athlete's playset: climbing platform, water-connected wave slide, gymnastic and horizontal bars, basketball hoop, scramble net, and knotted rope under an all-weather canopy. Designed for poolside and courtyard installations where activity density is prized.
contents: MaxiGlider Wave Slide with Water Connection (1)

products.name: Rebo Modular Climbing Frame
products.description: A canopied main tower with balcony deck, 2.65 m water slide, climbing wall, and sheltered sandpit below. Its modular platform system adapts to sloped or constrained sites with minimal groundwork.

products.name: Wooden Play Tower System
products.description: A central lookout under a red-trimmed gabled canopy, approached by wide entry steps and a suspended log bridge, resolved by a green wave slide. Vertical safety slats and semi-circular balcony rails give the system its distinctive, pavilion-like character.
contents: Gabled Canopy Roof with Red Trim (1)
Solid Wood Support Posts & Safety Barriers

products.name: Wooden Cottage Play Tower
products.description: An elevated cottage with gabled roof, reached by ladder or rock-hold ramp and connected to a guarded walkway bridge. Scaled precisely for early primary years, with low platform heights and continuous balustrades.
contents: Elevated Play House with Gabled Roof (1)
Slanted Climbing Ramp with Rock Holds (1)

products.name: Mini House
products.description: The Dream House silhouette, distilled: roofed tower, wave slide, climbing ramp, and twin swings in a footprint suited to private villas and pocket parks. Nothing reduced but the plan.

products.name: Little House
products.description: A deep-espresso tower with peaked roof and pennant flags, olive wave slide, twin swings, and a sandpit sheltered at its base. Little House pairs the collection's richest timber tone with its gentlest proportions.

products.name: Playtower with Slide
products.description: A pale-timber tower with Toba slide, five-stone climbing wall, and integrated sand play below — the ideal first tower for ages three and up. Four safety grab handles and a low fall height make it as reassuring as it is engaging.

products.name: Garden Swing Set with Slide
products.description: A robust A-frame swing with rope-ladder climber, ladder, and ground-level slide in warm-toned timber. Compact enough for private gardens; engineered for genuinely shared play.

products.name: My First Playground
products.description: A low-rise play street with roofed playhouse, 1.2 m slide, climbing ramp, ship's wheel, telescope, and an integrated activity desk. Every platform sits at 60 cm — high enough for adventure, low enough for peace of mind.

products.name: Toddler House
products.description: A roofed tower and twin platforms linked by crawl tube, curved ladder, and gentle ramp, with an X-O game panel and optional swing set. Toddler House choreographs early motor development into one continuous, supervisable circuit.

products.name: Cooper Climb & 1.8 m Slide
products.description: An A-frame base camp with wavy slide, mini rock wall, climbing net, and a curtained hideaway platform within. Cooper Climb packs four modes of play into under two and a half meters of length.

products.name: Climbing Pyramid Adventure
products.description: A tented timber A-frame with rock holds on both faces, fabric doors front and back, a side window, and a roof bell. For ages three to five, it is den, summit, and stage at once.

products.name: Forest Cabin Playhouse
products.description: A panelled cabin with gabled roof, front verandah, full-height door, and perspex windows — a genuine small building, joinery-built, from age two.

products.name: Playhouse Cottage & Slide
products.description: A ground-level cottage with verandah half-wall, paired with an elevated lookout tower and green wave slide under twin gabled roofs. The composition of a country retreat, at one-fifth scale.

products.name: Elevated Play House
products.description: A stilted cabin with green-trimmed windows, balustraded balcony, wooden stairs, and a long wave slide to the lawn. The elevated floor creates a shaded den beneath — two rooms in one silhouette.

products.name: School Giant Playhouse
products.description: An open-sided timber shelter with chalkboard, benches, and twelve den-making holes for fabric and rope play. A covered outdoor classroom that teaches construction, collaboration, and quiet retreat.

products.name: Wooden Toddlers House
products.description: Two slatted playhouses joined by a screen wall, with round port windows, arched doorways, and a freestanding chalkboard. Light passes through the slats — children remain visible from every angle, by design.

products.name: Playhouse & Sandbox
products.description: A cottage playhouse with planter boxes and window shutters, extended by a canopied, bottomless sandbox with protective cover. Domestic play and sensory play under one composition.

products.name: Sand Box Pavilion
products.description: A roofed sand house in deep espresso timber, its peaked canopy shading play through the warmest hours of the day. Flags at the gables; seashells optional.

products.name: Picnic & Sand Activity Table
products.description: A 2-in-1 activity table in honey-toned timber: benches for four, a removable tabletop, and a hidden sensory sand compartment beneath. Art table by morning, excavation site by afternoon.

products.name: Round Picnic Table
products.description: A round picnic table with four integrated benches and removable backrests, sized for ages three to eight. Natural-finish timber, 45 kg capacity per seat.

products.name: Garden Picnic Table
products.description: The classic A-frame picnic table, scaled for early years. Fifty-kilogram bench capacity and rounded edges throughout.

products.name: Zipline 30 m
products.description: Thirty meters of steel cable between engineered timber supports, with pendulum seat, trolley, and rubber bumpers. The signature element of any adventure program — and the one children queue for.

products.name: A-Frame Climbing Wall
products.description: A double-sided A-frame traverse wall with molded resin holds across four timber panels. Two children climb opposing faces at once; instructors see both from a single vantage.

products.name: Hexa Climb
products.description: A hexagonal climbing pavilion in dark timber with brass-toned fittings: rock wall, rung ladders, and suspended rings around a continuous circuit. Sculptural enough for a hotel forecourt; demanding enough for a PE program.

products.name: Climbing Set
products.description: Twin apple-hold climbing walls flanked by rope and rung ladders, a climbing ramp, and a short slide descent. A complete traverse-and-descend circuit in espresso-stained timber.

products.name: Palm Grove Agility Set
products.description: Monkey bars strung between palm-crowned posts, with a rock-hold ramp, balance decks, and boardwalk connections. An agility course that reads as landscape sculpture.

products.name: Discovery Trail
products.description: A linear obstacle sequence — barrel tunnel, log-and-stepping-post balance bridge, overhead monkey bars, and suspended stepping pods, all connecting low deck platforms. Ideal where a full playground footprint is unavailable but play value is required.
contents: Wooden Barrel Tunnel Crawl Element with Metal Bands and Window Cutouts (1)
Hanging Log / Stepping Post Balance Bridge with Chain Supports (1)
Overhead Monkey Bars / Hanging Metal Ring Bars (1)
Support Timber Posts and Guide Rails

products.name: Balance Bridge
products.description: A slatted suspension-style walkway between timber portals — a pure balance challenge with continuous upper rails on both sides.

products.name: See Saw
products.description: A plank see-saw for multiple riders, with hooped steel handholds at each end. Broad-board construction seats a small crowd rather than a pair.

products.name: Classic Swing
products.description: A three-seat A-frame swing in golden timber — the essential playground gesture, built to commercial standard.

products.name: Tic-Tac-Toe Stand
products.description: Nine rotating X-O cylinders between two mounted timber posts. Cognitive play at standing height, from age one.

products.name: Corn Climbing Pavilion
products.description: A palm-crowned open climbing pavilion with an integrated indoor/outdoor climbing wall, a rope grid net section, and low platforms — corn-themed play at architectural scale for gardens where a landmark is needed.
contents: Integrated Indoor / Outdoor Climbing Wall with Foot Holds (1)
Internal Structural Supporting Wood Pillars and Platforms (1)

products.name: Balance Suspension Bridge
products.description: A standalone slatted timber walkway carried between yellow-rope balustrades — a self-contained balance element that installs between existing play zones or as a garden feature in its own right.

products.name: Park Bench
products.description: Slatted hardwood seat and backrest on curved steel side frames, floor-anchored. A contemporary classic for promenades and pool decks.

products.name: Heritage Park Bench
products.description: The traditional silhouette in deep mahogany-toned slats on galvanized frames. At home beside fountains and formal planting.

products.name: The Orbit Curved Bench
products.description: A sweeping arc of fine timber slats on recessed steel plinths, composed to encircle ponds, trees, and gathering points. Supplied per segment; radii configured to the landscape plan.
products.dimensions: L 6.84 × W 3.52 × H 0.47 m per arc

products.name: Courtyard Loop Bench, Backless
products.description: A minimal slatted top on continuous brushed-steel loops, anchored to hard landscape. Reads from both sides — ideal between facing play zones.

products.name: Garden Bench with Back
products.description: Boxed steel side frames carry a generous slatted seat and twin-board back. The workhorse of the collection, in the most architectural of its forms.

products.name: Conservatory Bench, Backless
products.description: A refined backless form in warm timber on dark steel hoops, drawn for garden walks and glasshouse courts.

products.name: Promenade Rail Bench, 4.4 m
products.description: A 4.4-meter continuous bench with intermittent backrest panels, for boulevards and long garden walls.

products.name: Hoop Bench, Noir
products.description: Timber slats suspended between two powder-coated steel rings — a graphic, sculptural profile in matte black.

products.name: Arc Bench, Signature Yellow
products.description: The Hoop Bench profile re-drawn in the Soliwood signature palette — arched tubular frames in gloss yellow beneath warm timber slats.

site.name: Soliwood
site.description: Soliwood designs, engineers, manufactures, and installs premium wooden playground environments for the world's finest addresses — master-planned communities, international schools, and destination resorts.
